$comment: Telemetry egress allowlist (SPEC-007 §4.3, §2.1, §3.1, §5.2, §5.3, §5.4; EP-008 M1). The classification of every emitted field is DATA, NOT A CODE COMMENT (§4.3): a field with no entry here is DENIED at runtime. Dispositions are a closed set: ALLOW (no privacy surface), ALLOW_WITH_REDACTION (permitted only with a tenant policy row, an entry here, and an unconditional deterministic redaction pass), DENY_BY_DEFAULT (permitted only with the tenant policy row of §4.3, which no environment in this repository has yet), DENY (no telemetry exception). Every canonical resource key carries the §2.1 fail-closed reason code as its on_resolution_failure value; a reader can count them with `grep -c` over this file and must get exactly nine, one per key. CONTROL VARIANT: EMAIL_ADDRESS disabled, written into the evidence directory by scripts/egress-canary-test.sh. NOT a shipped configuration.
spec: SPEC-007 §4.3 (EgressClass model), §2.1 (nine canonical resource keys), §3.1-§3.2 (span attributes), §5.2-§5.4 (structured log contract)

dispositions.ALLOW: structural or non-reversible data; no privacy surface
dispositions.ALLOW_WITH_REDACTION: permitted only with a tenant policy row, this entry, and an unconditional deterministic redaction pass leaving at most the opaque reference
dispositions.DENY_BY_DEFAULT: no tenant policy row in this repository permits it, so it is denied by default (VG-EGRESS-001)
dispositions.DENY: denied unconditionally, including for model egress, issues and PRs

dlp_rule_classes_note: THE TWELVE RULE CLASSES ARE THE §4.2 TABLE, ONE ROW EACH, AND EACH DECLARES HOW IT IS ENFORCED. VALUE_PATTERN classes are detected in a field value and redacted to the required representation; FIELD_NAME classes are enforced by the prohibited-name rule of §5.3, because a subject's name or a session value has no shape a scanner could recognise; EGRESS_CLASS classes are enforced by the §4.3 disposition of the field they would travel in, because an identity document or a form payload is characterised by what it is, not by what it looks like. A class whose enforcement is honestly impossible by value is recorded as such rather than given a pattern that would look like coverage. Every class carries enabled: true in the shipped configuration; enabled: false is a CONTROL-ONLY state used by the canary stage to prove the canary assertion can fail, it is recorded in the gate's own diagnostics when it happens, and tests/observability/egress-canary.test.ts asserts that every class in the SHIPPED file is enabled.

dlp_rule_classes.note: a person's name has no reliable shape; the control is that the field name is prohibited and that displayRef is refused by the domain when it carries apparent personal data

dlp_rule_classes.representation: LocationHistory opaque ID, or a Jurisdiction code when only the jurisdiction is needed
EvidenceArtifact digest plus a redacted excerpt summary

dlp_rule_classes.note: fetched page text is text; the control is that the field names body, content, pageContent, raw and payload are prohibited and that external text is logged as a length and a digest

dlp_rule_classes.representation: never represented; the field does not exist

dlp_rule_classes.note: a document number or a scan is identified by the field it travels in, and that field is denied by class rather than by value

dlp_rule_classes.representation: ExternalAction opaque ID plus the recipe field identifier
dlp_rule_classes.note: a form value is indistinguishable from ordinary text once it is a string; the control is that formValues is a prohibited field name and that a submission is represented by the action id

dlp_rule_classes.representation: EvidenceArtifact digest; never attached to telemetry or issues
dlp_rule_classes.note: image payloads are large opaque blobs; the control is that screenshot, imageBase64 and attachment are prohibited field names

dlp_rule_classes.representation: opaque note ID; notes are stored in the case store, not telemetry

resource_key_note: TWO RESOURCE KEYS ARE EXEMPT FROM THE LEAF-NAME PROHIBITION, AND ONLY THEY ARE. §5.3 prohibits the field NAME `name` at any nesting depth, while §2.1 mandates the resource attributes `service.name` and `deployment.environment.name`. The prohibition is aimed at a record field that would carry a subject's name; a resource attribute is not a record field, and §2.1 names these nine keys as the only canonical ones. A checker that applies the leaf-name rule to a resource key MUST raise the conflict rather than silently exempt it, and MUST NOT extend the exemption to any other key.
prohibited_classes_note: The prohibited NAME list is the second line of defence behind the deny-by-default allowlist (§5.3). It is data here so the checker and the canary generator read one list; the §4.2 CLASS list (subject names, contact details, identity documents, credentials, page and message bodies, screenshots) is what the canary generator of §4.4 shapes its values after, and it lives with that generator in EP-008 M2.
